page.overview:
Who is Alien Grey?

Alien Grey is a Duel Monster Spirit in Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links. It appears as an opponent in the D.D. Tower: Sacred Light Dimension event. This is the character version of the card "Alien Grey".
